payload.author: claude
payload.body: Conformance scenario runner landed + committed efc1840 (in review). crates/frick-conformance: black-box suite driving an arbitrary server over HTTP+WS, ServerHandle::target() boots an in-process Rust server (productTestSchema decoded from the committed wire fixture) by default OR targets a running TS server via FRICK_CONFORMANCE_URL. 13 scenarios: lifecycle, auth (dev-login/signup/login/401), object CRUD, stream append/read/idempotency, presence/signals, WS handshake (Hello→HelloAck+Schema), handshake gate, Ping→Pong, object subscribe→Snapshot→live Delta, stream subscribe→StreamPage→Delta, projection subscribe→ProjectionDelta. Combined with the FR-238 golden wire fixtures (73 cases) + FR-239 lint fixtures (81) + codegen + migrations fixtures, the conformance layer is now substantial. The suite immediately CAUGHT + I FIXED a real wire-parity bug: gateway object-Delta fan-out dropped rows for schema types with no declared id field (productTestSchema User) — pack_object_record errored on the injected id key; now stripped before packing (matches TS withoutRecordId), guarded by a new scenario. Remaining for FR-250: wire the suite into CI to run against BOTH the TS server (pnpm server w/ productTestSchema) and the Rust server.
